parts.title: Proposed gift: five works from Magnum Photos 75

media.alt_text: Vertical black-and-white photograph of a back-facing armed figure and rifle overlooking a canvas shelter in a rocky desert valley.
media.credit_line: David Seymour, Negev, 1952. © David Seymour/Magnum Photos 2022.

media.alt_text: Black-and-white photograph of two armed soldiers standing symmetrically inside a church beneath a large crucifix.
media.credit_line: Larry Towell, Suchitoto, El Salvador, 1986. © Larry Towell/Magnum Photos 2022.

media.alt_text: Black-and-white photograph of a person running through tear gas at the Western Wall, with a canister in the air and a metal menorah barrier in the foreground.
media.credit_line: Micha Bar-Am, Jerusalem, 1989. © Micha Bar-Am/Magnum Photos 2022.

media.alt_text: Black-and-white photograph of a child standing with head lowered before a white wall pocked by many impact marks, beneath a caged lamp.
media.credit_line: Moisés Saman, Tripoli, Libya, 2011. © Moisés Saman/Magnum Photos 2022.

media.alt_text: Color photograph of a soldier holding a helmet to his face while seated among pale rubble and standing columns at Palmyra under a clear blue sky.
media.credit_line: Lorenzo Meloni, Palmyra, Syria, 2016. © Lorenzo Meloni/Magnum Photos 2022.

submission_notes: Submit all seven parts as one Storm drop so the parent drop remains the single TDH voting object.
Attach the exact source image named in each work part; do not upload a marketplace screenshot or substitute crop.
Retain each visible credit line and All Rights Reserved label.
Before submission, replace the draft source edition with the merged immutable Git commit and update the finalized-block chain observation.
Do not post this package through an automation account; the donor stated that the donor will submit the proposal.
